data.content: IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW PASS by Codex, verdict-only. Reviewed Claude's VERIFY_BOUNCE plus source. Q1 refuted: codex read-only-with-artifacts intentionally runs workspace-write in a private temp cwd and copyCodexArtifactsBack promotes only .md/.json; codex workspace-write allows system-wide reads, so repo readability via absolute paths is preserved while repo writes remain confined. Changing cwd to projectRoot would weaken 9331 and is rejected. Q2 folded into hive-flow-5799: source persists ownerSessionId/ownerClientKind, injects owner env/projectRoot into bridge children, and routes by persisted owner stamp; any residual is MCP-child session-id/env handshake, not provider source. No code to land.
